In 2018, we set out to deliver entrepreneurship courses to high school students in a conflict zone. Internet and laptop access was scarce. Almost everyone had a phone, so we built the entire course as text messages.

That workaround became a new way to reach people conventional systems left behind: students without laptops, frontline teams without desks, and employees without a spare hour for a portal. Over the next seven years, Arist delivered millions of courses to students, frontline employees, and managers inside the world’s largest organizations.
AI made that possible. Today, Arist’s research agents interview the people closest to a problem, analyze internal data, and help leaders understand what’s blocking excellence and what to do next.
As part of that commitment, Arist partners with nonprofits and social-good organizations to deliver learning at scale at a free or discounted rate, depending on need.
